page.overview:
What is Adventure Balloon Boy?

, commonly referred to as Adventure BB, is an unlockable character in FNaF World and minor character in the Gravity Vortex, Lemonade Clown, and Fruit Punch Clown minigames in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator.

Balloon Boy has an almost identical appearance to his counterpart from the main Five Nights at Freddy's series, but is smaller and cuter. All of his distinct features remain, such as the red-blue vertically striped shirt, two white buttons, propeller cap, blue pants, and brown shoes. He doesn't carry the "Balloons!" sign from his original appearance, and his hair color has been brightened. His eyes aren't as round as his original counterpart, and he has a bigger smile than usual.

Balloon Boy relies on attacking groups of enemies. His Balloons is mainly useful to one enemy as it summons 3 Balloons to random targets. Each Balloon can do random damage from weak as 1 damage to huge as around 100. Because of these numbers, Balloon Boy does not do too much damage on bosses, so be careful. Hot Cheese and Munchies are useful on groups of enemies.
